purpose: VGT-21 K-pop evaluation set (docs/kpop-eval-protocol.md). Measurement only: never training data. References are local consensus LAB files built from public chord sheets; they stay outside the repository. Two annotation roots share these relative paths: the majmin view (majmin, root) and the sevenths view (sevenths).

vgt21-kpop-v1.name: VGT-21 K-pop consensus references v1 (local, not distributed)
vgt21-kpop-v1.licence: personal use only; derived from public chord sheets; never committed or shared
vgt21-kpop-v1.attribution: Consensus of public human-made chord sheets (sources recorded locally), timed to the capture by the VGT-21 alignment tool, differences resolved by the user
vgt21-kpop-v1.btcTraining: not-known (recent Korean releases; BTC training lists do not include them)
